## Walkthrough This PR adds design documentation for an enhancement to support selecting OS streams per Release Image. The proposal defines new cluster and AgentClusterInstalls fields, a new endpoint for listing available OS streams, selection and fallback behavior, implementation notes, UI impact, testing, risks, and an alternative design. ## Changes **OS Streams Enhancement Proposal** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Enhancement proposal and supporting sections**
